t: A tiny audio computer for building effects pedals, synths, and music gadgets.
steps: Buy the Daisy Seed3 from the official Daisy store. It costs about 35 US dollars.
Get a USB-C cable, a breadboard, and audio jack breakouts.
Wire the audio output and plug in headphones or a powered speaker.
Open the Daisy web programmer in a browser and flash a ready example.
Install the Arduino IDE and add the DaisyDuino library.
Open a simple synth example and upload it to the board.
Add a knob to an analog pin and change the sound as you turn it.
Explore the DaisyExamples collection for effects and samplers next.
meta: Open Board. From $24. A few stores.
